hints.title: Null Value Elimination
hints.text: When records contain missing attributes in mandatory fields, those specific rows must be pruned. Which DataFrame method removes rows containing null values?

hints.title: Targeted Column Subsetting
hints.text: Calling dropna without parameters removes rows with nulls in any column. How can you restrict the check strictly to the name column?

hints.title: Subset Keyword Argument
hints.text: Specify the subset parameter: students.dropna(subset=['name']) to discard only records where the name column is null.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of rows in students DataFrame
complexity.notes: Single vector scan over the target column to construct a filtered index mask.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual iteration with iterrows or dropna across all columns drops rows with valid names that happen to miss other optional fields.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating the filtered DataFrame requires O(N) memory proportional to non-null survivors.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct usage of the subset parameter to avoid over-dropping rows with missing values in other columns.

solutions.approach: Vectorized dropna with target column subset
